sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report is filed regarding an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern identified under internal case AC-HHF-013. The investigation involves customer C06115 and credit card C06115-K1, which is linked via cross-card telemetry to 16 other cards paying a common recipient email domain. On 2017-01-05 at 16:51, an online transaction (id 3660311) for $181.16 was conducted under product code C in billing region 203.0 with recipient domain sc.rr.com. On 2017-01-22 at 19:57, a second online transaction (id 3660312) for $140.59 was conducted under product code C in billing region 191.0 to the same recipient domain sc.rr.com. These transactions form part of a coordinated recipient-email mule ring across 17 total cards with no shared device profile. This activity represents unusual online product code C transfers to an external recipient domain, departing from the cardholder's baseline as of opening of 83 prior transactions predominantly in person in modal region 123.0. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card, and OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. Case AC-HHF-013 was opened, connected card monitoring was initiated, and analyst escalation was performed; a block of card C06115-K1 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this report filing is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval, covering a total suspicious amount of $321.75.
